# Exercise No No

> Step-by-step home exercises with start and finish illustrations, the common mistakes to avoid, and printable workout charts for every level.

Exercise No No (https://www.exercisenono.com) publishes free, illustrated exercise guides with start and finish positions, step-by-step instructions and common mistakes. Printable PDF versions (A4 and US Letter) are sold by The Shop Curator on Etsy. General information, not medical advice.
